caption:
Toto's shoulder starting to grumble after squad or ocean swims? Check what's changed in training.

Swimming can mean thousands of arm strokes every session. Most shoulders cope well, but big jumps in distance, new paddle or pull sets, or a run of long open water swims can outpace what your shoulder is ready for.

Hybi's plan: add load gradually, use kick sets, drills and backstroke to lighten a sore week, breathe to both sides, and do rotator cuff and shoulder blade work on land two or three times a week.

Night pain, weakness or pins and needles down the arm are worth an assessment. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🏊

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
